metadata.desc:
Anguna is a short top-down fantasy action adventure game, reminiscent of the original Legend of Zelda. Featuring art by Chris Hildenbrand, it has 5 dungeons to explore.

Controls:
A - Attack
B - Secondary item
X/Y - Switch secondary item (if you have more then one)
Start - Pause, View subscreen
Select - Save menu
L/R - Switch between subscreen pages
metadata.name: Anguna - Warriors of Virtue
